newsitem.title: FRANCE: Car bomb kills nine south of Algerian capital.
newsitem.headline: Car bomb kills nine south of Algerian capital.

text.p: A car bomb killed nine people and wounded 33 on Thursday in Boufarik, 25 km (16 miles) south of the capital Algiers, the official Algerian news agency APS said.
The explosion took place at about 1220 GMT in the centre of Boufarik, the agency said, quoting security forces.
Boufarik is in the heart of a rich farming area and is close to the Moslem fundamentalist stronghold of Blida province.
APS said civilian protection units and security forces went to the aid of victims of what it called "this criminal act".
The authorities have blamed Moslem fundamentalists fighting to topple the government for previous bombings.
Earlier this month a car bomb killed four people and wounded 21, many of them schoolchildren, in Algiers.
